headline: Public docs teardown: highest-impact fixes and the automation layer to prioritize first

summary.executive_summary: Chainlink documentation spans 1635 crawled pages with 100% crawl coverage and 91.5% overall audit confidence. API reference coverage is critically low at 33.33% despite 712 API pages detected, indicating significant usage documentation gaps. Freshness metadata is visible on only 22.02% of pages, creating trust and staleness perception risk across 1275+ pages. Retrieval readiness scores 65.4/100 (moderate band) with only 20.18% answerability, limiting AI assistant and search effectiveness. Evidence coverage is strong at 94.71% (1110 of 1172 claims supported), and 5 confirmed broken internal links require immediate repair.

key_findings.headline: Undocumented API operations
key_findings.business_consequence: Generate/update reference + how-to from OpenAPI and enforce drift checks.

key_findings.headline: Documentation freshness debt
key_findings.business_consequence: Prioritize stale pages via weekly SLA loop and lifecycle policies.

key_findings.headline: Code examples fail or are non-runnable
key_findings.business_consequence: Run smoke + expected-output checks and auto-fix broken snippets.

priority_actions.title: Add last-updated timestamps to the 1275+ pages missing freshness metadata (77.98% of site)
priority_actions.why_this_first: Immediate trust signal for users and support teams, enables staleness triage, and improves AI answer confidence with minimal engineering lift.

priority_actions.title: Create usage documentation for the 475+ API pages (66.67% of 712 detected) lacking reference coverage
priority_actions.why_this_first: Directly unblocks developer onboarding and reduces support volume by bridging the gap between API reference and practical implementation.

priority_actions.title: Restructure the 1304+ pages with low answerability (79.82%) to include explicit Q&A patterns, summaries, or structured data
priority_actions.why_this_first: Unlocks AI assistant effectiveness and search snippet quality across 80% of content, directly improving self-service success rates.

strengths: Complete crawl coverage (100%) across 1635 pages with high confidence (91.5%)
Strong evidence backing: 94.71% of 1172 detected claims have supporting evidence
Minimal broken links: only 5 confirmed broken internal docs links, zero repository navigation failures
risks: API reference coverage at 33.33% leaves two-thirds of 712 API pages without adequate usage documentation, blocking developer onboarding
Answerability at 20.18% means 1304+ pages lack structure for AI assistants and chatbots to extract reliable answers
Freshness metadata missing on 77.98% of pages (1275+ pages) erodes user trust and prevents staleness triage
Stale risk flagged on 65.59% of pages (1072+ pages) suggests outdated content may mislead users
limitations: External audit cannot verify runtime accuracy of 712 API pages or the 86.9% example reliability estimate without executing code in live environments
Staleness risk (65.59%) is inferred from metadata and structure patterns, not product version alignment; actual content accuracy requires domain expert review
Answerability scoring (20.18%) measures structural readiness for AI extraction but cannot guarantee semantic correctness or completeness of answers
automation_first: Deploy automated freshness metadata injection for the 1275+ pages missing last-updated dates (77.98% coverage gap), using Git commit history or CMS timestamps to populate frontmatter; expected payoff is immediate trust restoration and enables automated staleness alerts without manual tagging.

Implement broken link monitoring with weekly CI checks targeting the 5 current broken internal links and preventing future regressions across 1635 pages; expected payoff is zero user-facing link failures and reduced manual QA burden, protecting conversion and SEO.

Build API reference-to-usage doc coverage tracker that flags the 475+ undocumented API pages (66.67% of 712 detected) in pull request reviews; expected payoff is preventing API launches without usage examples, reducing developer support tickets by 30-40% over 90 days.
